title: Relief Grooves for Grinding Zones and Thread
rules: Relief grooves for grinding zones must be compared with GROOVE UNI4386 standard
Relief grooves for thread must be made in case where the thread zone ends at a shoulder with ledge function
Groove dimensions vary by diameter range: 18-50mm, 51-80mm, 81-125mm, >125mm
Thread relief groove dimensions are specified by pitch (P): <1.25, 1.5-1.75-2, 2.5-3
Specific grooves must be indicated in details on drawing
Norma UNI = UNI regulation; Specifiche TRASMITAL = TRASMITAL specifications
dimensions: Grinding groove 18-50mm: width 2.5mm, depth 0.4mm, radius R 0.1, angle 30°
Grinding groove 51-80mm: width 3mm, depth 0.6mm, radius R 1...1.6, angle 30°
Grinding groove 81-125mm: width 4.5mm, depth 0.8mm, radius R 2.5, angle 30°
Grinding groove >125mm: width 7mm, depth 1.3mm, radius R4.0, angle 30°

Grinding groove 81-125mm: width ±0.3mm, depth ±0.4mm, tolerance ±0.3mm, radius tolerance ±2.5mm
Grinding groove >125mm: width tolerance ±0.2ⓑ, depth ±0.3mm, horizontal ±0.2mm

inspection: Compare grinding groove dimensions against UNI4386 standard
Verify groove presence at thread-to-shoulder junctions
Check specific groove details as indicated in drawing
manufacturing_notes: Grinding relief grooves facilitate grinding wheel clearance at shoulder transitions
Thread relief grooves prevent interference at thread runout zones
Groove geometry must accommodate grinding wheel radius and thread pitch
30° chamfer angle is standard for grinding grooves
Possible specific grooves must be indicated in drawing details
training_guidance: NX agent should automatically insert grinding relief grooves at ground diameter transitions based on diameter range
For diameters 18-50mm, apply 2.5mm wide x 0.4mm deep groove with R0.1 and 30° angle
For diameters 51-80mm, apply 3mm wide x 0.6mm deep groove with R1.0-1.6 and 30° angle
For diameters 81-125mm, apply 4.5mm wide x 0.8mm deep groove with R2.5 and 30° angle
For diameters >125mm, apply 7mm wide x 1.3mm deep groove with R4.0 and 30° angle
When generating threads adjacent to shoulders with ledge function, insert thread relief groove based on pitch
Apply 3.2 Ra surface finish to thread relief grooves
Validate groove geometry against UNI4386 standard for compliance
Flag any custom groove requirements for detailed drawing callout
summary: This page defines standard relief grooves for two applications: grinding zones (TAB-001) and thread runouts (TAB-002). Grinding relief grooves are dimensioned in four diameter ranges (18-50, 51-80, 81-125, >125mm) with specific widths, depths, radii and 30° angles, compared against UNI4386. Thread relief grooves are required where threads terminate at shoulders, with dimensions (R, A, B, T1, T2) varying by pitch range (<1.25, 1.5-2, 2.5-3mm) and requiring 3.2 Ra surface finish.
